models_evaluated: ML algorithm for ATTRwt detection developed on US heart failure cohorts

links.outcome: AUROC of US-developed ML algorithm on UK heart failure data versus proxy case definitions
links.effect: AUROC 0.84 (definitive) and 0.86 (possible) with combined primary and secondary care data; 0.68 to 0.78 with primary or secondary care data alone.
links.quote: The algorithm demonstrated strongest predictive ability when a combination of primary care and secondary care data were used (AUROC: 0.84 in definitive cohort and 0.86 in possible cohort).

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation of a US-developed machine learning risk model in a UK health database setting to detect cardiac amyloidosis; does not evaluate a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
